name: Resources (SA)
help: Displays local system memory and root-disk resource information.
long_help: On Windows, reports current memory usage and primary disk free/total space in MB. Linux emits raw /proc/meminfo and /proc/loadavg data plus /bin/df -k / output. macOS emits /usr/bin/vm_stat plus /bin/df -k / output. Linux and macOS therefore do not reproduce the compact Windows used/total summary.
